description: The exact moving planes the authoritative BigWarp registration was created against, taken from the QuPath project referenced by the saved ABBA state (whs_nissl_40um_ap_*.tiff, UINT8, 512x512). Re-deriving these from the raw Waxholm BrainGlobe reference volume is NOT equivalent: measured against these files a re-derivation is displaced by 22-25 voxels in LR, which reproduced as a ~880 um lateral offset in the built atlas.
uint16_scale_note: One constant factor for every plane (255*257 = 65535); relative intensity between planes is preserved. This is a range mapping, never per-slice normalization.
